title: Prototype workspace-scoped Mastra to Codex ACP handoff
description: Add a minimal Mastra tool that starts one local Codex ACP session scoped to this project in workspace-write mode, sends one task, and returns Codex’s actual result. This is a setup smoke-test slice, not the full bounded-delegation feature.
why: Validate that the existing Ollama-powered assistant can route one repository task to the user’s authenticated Codex CLI.

acceptance.text: Assistant exposes the delegation tool in Mastra Studio
Qwen3.5 produces a structured tool call that executes
A delegated task can create a file inside the project workspace
Codex is confined to the project workspace
README documents the Studio smoke-test prompt

repro.expected: Mastra assistant delegates an inspect-only task to Codex over ACP
repro.environment: Ollama running locally and Codex authenticated with ChatGPT login

outcome.summary: Implemented workspace-scoped Codex ACP delegation, switched to Qwen3.5, and verified file creation and readback from both the registered Mastra Agent and Mastra Studio. The Studio run exposed its process working directory under src/mastra/public; the handoff now resolves the project root by walking up to package.json plus src/mastra.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check passed; Agent.generate returned one delegateToCodex tool call and result; Studio streamed a delegateToCodex call and read the exact hello.txt contents; hello.txt remains unchanged after the read task
